Latest Review

I just turned the last page of I, Robot — Here's my take on it.

4.1

I, Robot is an excellent collection of short stories by Isaac Asimov, all centered around his famous "Three Laws of Robotics". Each story explores the idea that robots cannot violate these laws. Despite this seemingly simple premise, Asimov creates fascinating dilemmas, with every story presenting a unique challenge and an ingenious solution.

Favorite Quote

One line that's been on my mind lately from the book Solaris

I sat by the panoramic window, looking at the ocean. There was nothing to do now that the report, which had taken five days to compile, was only a pattern of waves in space. It would be month before a similar pattern would leave Earth to create its own line of disturbance in the gravitational field of the galaxy towards the twin suns of Solaris.
  • Stanisław Lem
